"""QA tests for SAVE10 percent-coupon fix."""
import pytest

from store.cart import Cart, Item
from store.coupons import CouponError


def test_issue_save10_two_lines():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="shirt", name="T-Shirt", price_cents=2500))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    # 3700 * 10 // 100 = 370
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 370


def test_issue_save10_quantities():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200, qty=3))
    cart.add(Item(sku="shirt", name="T-Shirt", price_cents=2500, qty=2))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    # subtotal 3600 + 5000 = 8600; 8600 * 10 // 100 = 860
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 860


def test_issue_halfoff_all_lines():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=1000))
    cart.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=2000))
    cart.apply_coupon("HALFOFF")
    # 3000 * 50 // 100 = 1500
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 1500


def test_issue_percent_rounds_down():
    """A percent coupon takes that percent off the whole subtotal, rounded down to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=999))
    cart.add(Item(sku="b", name="B", price_cents=100))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    # 1099 * 10 // 100 = 109 (109.9 floored)
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 109


def test_issue_total_uses_full_discount():
    """Total = discounted subtotal + shipping + tax, and is never negative."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="shirt", name="T-Shirt", price_cents=2500))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    # discounted 3700 - 370 = 3330; shipping 599; tax (3330*8+50)//100 = 266; total 3330+599+266 = 4195
    assert cart.total_cents() == 4195


def test_contract_second_coupon_raises():
    """At most one coupon may be applied to a cart."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.apply_coupon("SAVE10")
    with pytest.raises(CouponError):
        cart.apply_coupon("HALFOFF")


def test_contract_fixed_below_minimum():
    """A fixed coupon takes a flat amount off, but only when the subtotal is at least the coupon's minimum."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="cheap", name="Cheap", price_cents=1500))
    cart.apply_coupon("FIVEOFF")
    # subtotal 1500 < 2000 minimum, so discount 0
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 0


def test_contract_fixed_capped_at_subtotal():
    """The discount can never exceed the subtotal."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="cheap", name="Cheap", price_cents=300))
    cart.apply_coupon("TENOFF")
    # min(1000, 300) = 300
    assert cart.discount_cents() == 300


def test_contract_shipping_free_at_threshold():
    """Shipping is free when the discounted subtotal is $50.00 or more."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=2500, qty=2))
    # discounted subtotal 5000 >= 5000, so shipping 0
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0


def test_contract_shipping_below_threshold():
    """Shipping is a flat $5.99 when the discounted subtotal is below $50.00."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=4999))
    # discounted subtotal 4999 < 5000, so shipping 599
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 599


def test_contract_empty_no_shipping():
    """An empty cart has no shipping charge."""
    cart = Cart()
    # empty subtotal 0, so shipping 0
    assert cart.shipping_cents() == 0


def test_contract_tax_half_up():
    """Tax is 8% of the discounted subtotal, rounded half up to the cent."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="a", name="A", price_cents=719))
    # (719 * 8 + 50) // 100 = 5802 // 100 = 58 (floor would be 57)
    assert cart.tax_cents() == 58


def test_contract_add_same_sku_increases_qty():
    """Adding a SKU that is already in the cart increases that line's qty."""
    cart = Cart()
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    cart.add(Item(sku="mug", name="Mug", price_cents=1200))
    # 1 + 1 = 2
    assert cart.items[0].qty == 2
